headline: Names a Houston, Texas postal facility after former Congressman George Thomas "Mickey" Leland.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 4110 Almeda Road in Houston, Texas. The building is now officially called the "George Thomas 'Mickey' Leland Post Office Building." It is a naming measure only and does not change postal services, rules, or staffing.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 16, 2014.
